title: Executive daily priorities - 2026-03-04
content:
Morning run-down (quick):
- Today focus: Dedicated launch checklist, Dedicated capacity SLO review, ops staffing for east-region pilot.
- Do not block: avoid long deep dives before 2pm - heads-down for proposal sync.

Top 3 priorities (today):
1) Dedicated launch gates - sign-off or escalate by EOD
   - Action: final infra SLO doc (Emma) + capacity forecast (Rohit) -> need both by 3pm.
   - My role: review SLO doc, confirm rollback/fallback policy language, approve communication.
2) Customer pilot readiness (AcmeCorp) - final checklist and runbook
   - Confirm data security checklist done (legal ok?) -> ping Sarah in legal.
   - Ensure private deployment package includes KMS steps + network diagram.
3) Exec weekly - prep talking points for Board update (Thu)
   - Key asks: Dedicated capacity contracts, Private deployment pipeline, go-to-market recommended pricing bands.

Meeting prep / time blocks:
- 9:00-9:30 1:1 with Emma (SLO doc review) - bring latest SLO doc, highlight tolerances and fallback flow.
- 10:00-11:00 Leadership sync - short updates (I will cover Dedicated status + risk register).
- 11:30-12:00 AcmeCorp runbook walk-through w/solutions eng (go over onboarding steps).
- 13:00-14:00 Block for feedback on PR #312 (runtime autoscaler) - prioritize latency regression notes.
- 15:30-16:00 Weekly GTM check-in (pricing + trial packaging).
- 17:00 Buffer: final review + send EOD notes.

Follow-ups / action items (quick list):
- [ ] Read and comment on infra-SLO-draft.docx (Emma) - due 14:30.
- [ ] Approve capacity forecast spreadsheet (Rohit) - due 15:00.
- [ ] Ping Sarah (legal) re: AcmeCorp NDA items + KMS verbiage.
- [ ] Confirm on-call rotation coverage for east-region pilot week (SRE).
- [ ] Draft Board slide for Dedicated revenue projection (2 slides) - include ARR assumptions + conversion funnel.

Notes to self / context fragments (scratch):
- Last week's beta surfaced 2 latency cliffs at 8k token windows; need to confirm kernel fallback order (GPU->CPU->quantized) in release notes.
- Consider adding a small blurb in Console about "expected latency bands" for Dedicated vs Hosted. Low friction way to set customer expectations.
- Costs: check Optimize team's recommendation on batching defaults - might shave 12-15% per-token on high concurrency.

Open questions / decisions to make:
- Do we require a signed MSA before spinning up a Dedicated pool for pilots? (pros: legal protection; cons: friction). Bring to leadership sync.
- If AcmeCorp needs on-prem, timeline pushes 6-8 weeks - can we offer a hybrid (VPC + managed infra) interim? Need ops feasibility.

Quick links / refs:
- SLO draft: confluence:INF-705-rolling-deploys
- Capacity forecast: drive:shared_drives/product/dedicated/capacity-forecast-2026-q2.xlsx
- PR for autoscaler: github:repo/redwood/runtime#312
- Jira: ENG-1423 (latency regression triage)

End-of-day deliverables:
- EOD email: status on Dedicated gates + list of any escalations (if SLO docs incomplete).
- Updated Board slide deck stub in /shared_drives/company/presentations/board-2026-q1 (put notes under slide 2).

Random quick reminders:
- Ping Matt for hiring update on infra SRE role.
- Confirm lunch with investor Monday (12:30) - topic: GTM cadence for Dedicated.

Tone/notes: keep this doc informal - scratchpad for my morning flow. If something urgent comes up, I'll move items to the executive task board.

-- avery
